60: func GetObjectsWithFilter[CT, T kubeinterfaces.ObjectInterface](
61: 	ctx context.Context,
62: 	controller metav1.Object,
63: 	controllerGVK schema.GroupVersionKind,
64: 	selector labels.Selector,
65: 	filterFunc func(T) bool,
66: 	filterObjectsSelector labels.Selector,
67: 	control ControlleeManagerGetObjectsInterface[CT, T],
68: ) (map[string]T, error) {
69: 	// List all objects to find even those that no longer match our selector.
70: 	// They will be orphaned in ClaimObjects().
71: 	allObjects, err := control.ListObjects(filterObjectsSelector)
72: 	if err != nil {
73: 		return nil, err
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	var objects []T
77: 	for _, obj := range allObjects {
78: 		if filterFunc(obj) {
79: 			objects = append(objects, obj)
80: 		}
81: 	}
82: 
83: 	return controllertools.NewControllerRefManager[T](
84: 		ctx,
85: 		controller,
86: 		controllerGVK,
87: 		selector,
88: 		controllertools.ControllerRefManagerControlFuncsConverter[CT, T]{

90: 				return control.GetControllerUncached(ctx, name, opts)
91: 			},

93: 				return control.PatchObject(ctx, name, pt, data, opts, subresources...)
94: 			},
95: 		}.Convert(),
96: 	).ClaimObjects(objects)
97: }
